# iCanvas

> > iCanvas is an online gallery offering curated canvas art prints, framed wall art, and home decor across diverse subject categories from landscapes and animals to motivational and advocacy art.

iCanvas specializes in canvas prints and wall art across multiple aesthetic categories, featuring work from artists like Leonid Afremov, Carol Robinson, and Jan Becke. The site organizes its collection by subject matter, allowing customers to browse and purchase art for home decoration and gallery walls.

## Shop by Subject

- [All Art Subjects](https://www.icanvas.com/canvas-art-prints/subject): Browse all subject categories and themes of canvas art prints
- [Scenic & Landscape Art](https://www.icanvas.com/canvas-art-prints/subject/scenic-landscapes): Scenic landscape canvas prints and wall art collection
- [Animal Art](https://www.icanvas.com/canvas-art-prints/subject/animals): Animal art including pets, wildlife and sea life canvas prints
- [Explore Animal Art](https://www.icanvas.com/explore-animal-art): Animal art collection: wildlife, pets, sea life & exotic creatures
- [Nature Art](https://www.icanvas.com/canvas-art-prints/subject/nature): Nature art canvas prints including floral, gardens & landscapes
- [Beach Art](https://www.icanvas.com/canvas-art-prints/subject/beaches): Beach and coastal canvas prints with sandy, rocky & tropical themes
- [Mountain Art](https://www.icanvas.com/canvas-art-prints/subject/mountains): Mountain landscape canvas prints and wall art collection
- [Forest Art](https://www.icanvas.com/canvas-art-prints/subject/forests): Forest and nature landscape canvas prints and wall art
- [Ocean Art](https://www.icanvas.com/canvas-art-prints/subject/ocean): Ocean and seascape canvas prints and wall art collection
- [Sunrise & Sunset Art](https://www.icanvas.com/canvas-art-prints/subject/sunrises-sunsets): Sunrise and sunset landscape canvas prints and wall art
- [Urban Art](https://www.icanvas.com/canvas-art-prints/subject/urban): Urban cityscapes and skyline canvas prints and wall art
